t: Strong and durable nylon metric and imperial soft-close blade in an impact-resistant, comfort-grip case with shock-absorbing rubber design. Bi-directional tape hook is ideal for measuring in different positions, printed on both sides to make it suitable for roofing and uneven work areas. Ideal for one person operation on metal and non-metal surfaces due to True Zero magnetic hook for precise inner and outer measurements. With an error tolerance of +/-0.5mm at 1m. Features 2-release buttons and an auto stop facility as well as a belt clip and lanyard hole to secure to a belt, pocket or waistband for added safety and portability.
